voice.summary: Sounds like a garden fete announcer: bright, quick and slightly daft. Scores arrive with a grin and decoys get a gentle warning.
dos: Use short exclamations for hits, one per round
Name the garden things: moles, gnomes, mounds

boilerplate: Tuft & Burrow makes garden games for a sunny afternoon, from a thirty-second whack-a-mole with decoy gnomes to quieter lawn puzzles, all painted by hand.

logo.note: A target ring is the one thing every player is aiming at.
